data.gender_notes: Naseel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-l', meaning 'to give, to send'. It symbolizes the growth and development of a new generation, representing a shoot, offspring or successor. The name Naseel carries the meaning “A shoot, offspring, successor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naseel usually hope their child will grow to embody a shoot, offspring, successor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
